name: Garnier Men Acno Fight Anti-Pimple Facewash 50ml

Garnier Men Acno Fight Anti-Pimple Facewash 50ml
Goodness of Salicylic Actives & Herba Repair .
Controls Oil, Gel Based .
Dry Pimples .

Reduce Redness and Lighten Marks .
